summary: Reviews sell this as blunt-force action craft: "brutal, hard-hitting, exhilarating" and built from a world that feels physical. It is a strong fit when everyone wants relentless survival-movie momentum, not a light historical drama.

maybe_skip_if: Graphic violence or historical framing concerns will derail the night
